content.short: LatAm wallet, merchant payments and financial services platform.
content.description: Mercado Pago is the financial services arm of MercadoLibre and one of Latin America's largest digital wallets and payment platforms, serving consumers and merchants across countries like Argentina, Brazil, Mexico, and Chile. For individuals it functions as a full financial app: a digital account and wallet, debit and prepaid cards, QR payments, credit, savings and investment products, and even crypto trading in some markets. For businesses, Mercado Pago provides online checkout, in-person QR and card acceptance, and lending, tightly integrated with the MercadoLibre marketplace. By combining everyday money management with a vast merchant network, Mercado Pago has become a cornerstone of financial inclusion and cashless payments throughout the region.
content.meta: Mercado Pago is a leading LatAm wallet, payments, and financial services platform. Discover Mercado Pago and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
